name: Matsushima Michiru
source:
She's the same energetic, dumb blonde with pigtails you know from "The Fruit of Grisaia." However, in this parallel story, she works as an underground idol. Although she can't get more than one or two fans, her life is turned upside down when the cat Nyanmel turns her into a magical girl so she can save the world from evil.

[From [url=https://www.facebook.com/FrontwingINT/photos/a.1633584283526141.1073741829.1633299420221294/1666157503602152/?type=3&theater]Frontwing[/url]]
